svg.text: AUTONOMOUS FINOPS & APIM GENAI GATEWAY TOPOLOGY
Governing High-Velocity LLM Tool Sprawls: Token-Bucket Governors, Sub-2ms Rejection, and Azure AI Foundry

g.text: • Calling Identity: Entra ID Workload JWT

• KQL Sentinel: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
• Trigger: CallCount > 12 OR TotalTokens > 18,000 OR Depth > 4
• Action: 🛑 TRIP CIRCUIT BREAKER & QUARANTINE AGENT WORKLOAD
• Dispatches Azure Event Grid event: Microsoft.Foundry.CircuitBreakerTripped
• Revokes Entra ID App Role Assignment via Microsoft Graph v2.x

✔ Autonomous remediation in < 8 seconds without human pager
